definitions.votes_final: the resolved final count (highest-ranked source, then the most-corroborated); AV and STV contests only; blank for a candidate eliminated before the final count
definitions.share_first: votes_first / sum of votes_first within the contest (share of votes cast, not of electors)
definitions.share_final: AV: votes_final / sum of votes_final over the candidates still in at the final count, with at least two such candidates including the winner. STV: votes_final / the valid votes (first-count total) for the elected and the runner-up (the unelected candidate with the highest final tally); blank for candidates eliminated earlier
definitions.margin: share of the m-th candidate minus the (m+1)-th, m = magnitude; on the final count where share_final exists (STV: the lowest elected final share minus the runner-up's, where a runner-up has a final tally)
definitions.magnitude: count of elected candidates in the contest
definitions.formula: from review/electoral_systems/nonplurality_contests.csv (AV/STV split by magnitude); else block when magnitude > 1, else FPTP
definitions.turnout_pct: 100 * votes_total / electorate, contested FPTP contests only
definitions.quality: confidence rating: A corroborated and clean; B single-source or resolved by rule; C incomplete or disputed; D winner or totals in doubt
definitions.outcome_kind: an atypical outcome on record for the contest, from review/electoral_systems/district_outcomes.csv: no_poll, voided_no_result, tie_unfilled, tie_casting_vote, tie_lot, tie_rerun, seated_on_petition, recount_reversed, voided, voided_rerun, challenge_dismissed, deferred; null for the ordinary contest. outcome_note_en / outcome_note_fr say what happened; outcome_filled_by how the seat was eventually filled
definitions.person_key: internal grouping by normalized name within a province; regenerated every build; not exposed
definitions.source_use: which source supplied each resolved data point per province-election and field: name = canonical_name_source, party = party_resolved_source, votes = votes_resolved_source, winner = win_resolved_source (ppb_external / ola_external are outside membership records), eligible = eligible_source (Table 1); n = rows; dq = data point quality (DQ, 1-5, 5 best): the source's most common transcription grade among its rows for that election
definitions.label_scheme: party, or alignment for an election the sources classify by the candidates' stance toward the ministry rather than by party (Manitoba 1870-1879, British Columbia 1875-1900; review/electoral_systems/label_scheme.csv). In an alignment election a candidate's family is the alignment (Government, Opposition, Independent) and party_raw keeps the party, where a source gives one
definitions.party_family: the candidate's party family whatever the election is grouped by: equals family in a party election; in an alignment election, the party a source gives (none where it gives none)
definitions.alignment: where the candidate stood toward the ministry (Government, Opposition, Independent) or on Confederation, from alignment_resolved; recorded wherever a source gives it, whatever the election's label_scheme
definitions.tier: major: won the largest caucus (ties included) in some election of some province; minor: otherwise won 2+ seats or 5 %+ of first-count votes cast in some province-election; residual: the rest, and always none / other / Independent; review/atlas/party_families.csv tier column overrides
